Explain why the with statement is used for files.

Supplied answer
# without with - you must close it yourself
f = open("data.txt", "r")
content = f.read()
f.close() # easy to forget!
# with - closes the file automatically, even if an error happens
with open("data.txt", "r") as f:
    content = f.read()
print("File closed?", f.closed) # True
Note: with is a context manager: it guarantees the file is closed.
